material_class.structural_family: Twofold-interpenetrated (3,6)-connected scu-type metal–organic framework with dinuclear Eu(III) nodes

measurements.conditions: Transient absorption after 400 nm excitation; biexponential fit
measurements.name: Ligand-to-Eu-node electron-transfer time

properties.summary: The framework absorbs in the UV and visible regions. Its Ru(phen)-centered emission is strongly quenched relative to the free metalloligand, with faster photoluminescence decay and transient-absorption evidence of electron transfer to the Eu nodes; characteristic Eu(III) f–f emission was not observed.

source_locations.location: Results, “Synthesis and structural determination of Eu-Ru(phen)-MOF”; Fig. 2
Results, “Absorption and PL analyses” and “Ultrafast transient absorption and EPR characterizations”; Fig. 4
Methods, single-crystal X-ray diffraction determination; Data availability

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Six-connected dinuclear [Eu2(μ2-H2O)(H2O)3(-COO−)6] nodes alternate with three-connected, propeller-like Ru(phen)-derived tricarboxylate metalloligands to form a 3D scu-type framework. Two equivalent networks interpenetrate; the individual framework has one-dimensional channels along [010].

synthesis.procedure: Eu(NO3)3·6H2O, H3L, 2-fluorobenzoic acid (2-FBA), and DMF were sealed in a 20 mL Teflon-lined autoclave and heated in a preheated oven at 105 °C for 70 h. Cooling to room temperature yielded red block-shaped crystals.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Sealed 20 mL Teflon-lined autoclave; solvothermal heating
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature; red block-shaped crystals obtained.

properties.summary: In a comparative luminescence-quenching experiment, adding this discrete Eu2 cluster to the Ru metalloligand H3L in DMF efficiently quenched the ligand emission. The article does not report an intrinsic emission measurement for the isolated cluster.

source_locations.location: Discussion, comparative discrete Eu2 cluster; Supplementary Methods cited but not supplied

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete dinuclear Eu cluster used as an analogue of the Eu2 secondary building unit in Eu-Ru(phen)-MOF. The main article does not establish a more detailed assembly description for this reference compound.

synthesis.procedure: The article states that the discrete Eu2 methacrylate cluster can be synthesized and refers to Supplementary Methods and an earlier crystallographic report; it gives no preparation quantities or procedure in the main text.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Hydrothermal synthesis in a 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless steel autoclave under autogenous pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After cooling to room temperature, block-shaped crystals were washed with water and dried in air.

title: Photo-generated dinuclear {Eu(II)} active sites for selective CO2 reduction in a photosensitizing metal-organic framework
